Title: Package and PackageVersion Models
Summary: Models representing a package and its versions retrieved from a plugin server.
Content:
# Package and PackageVersion Models

## Namespace
`Cyrena.Extensa.Models`

## Package

Represents a plugin package retrieved from a distribution server.

### Properties

### Id (required)
```csharp
public required string Id { get; set; }
```
Unique identifier for the package.

### Name (required)
```csharp
public required string Name { get; set; }
```
Display name of the package.

### Description
```csharp
public string? Description { get; set; }
```
Package description.

### ServerId
```csharp
public string? ServerId { get; set; }
```
ID of the server this package was retrieved from.

### Versions
```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<PackageVersion> Versions { get; set; } = [];
```
Available versions for this package.

---

## PackageVersion

Represents a specific version of a package.

### Properties

### Version (required)
```csharp
public required string Version { get; set; }
```
Semantic version string (e.g., "1.2.3").

### ReleaseNotes
```csharp
public string? ReleaseNotes { get; set; }
```
Release notes or changelog.

### ReleaseDate
```csharp
public DateTimeOffset? ReleaseDate { get; set; }
```
When this version was released.

### DownloadUrl (required)
```csharp
public required string DownloadUrl { get; set; }
```
Direct URL to download this version as a ZIP archive.

### Hash
```csharp
public string? Hash { get; set; }
```
SHA-256 content hash for verification (format: "sha256:...").

### Size
```csharp
public long? Size { get; set; }
```
File size in bytes.

## See Also
- `PackageQueryOptions` for querying packages
- `IPluginPackageService` for retrieving packages
